scheduling.mode: Rolling queue: start the next ready card as soon as a slot is free. Do not wait for every stream or manufacture work for all roles.
scheduling.early_audio: Coordinator retrieves and compares retained gun references during first dispatch; AUD-01 enters the next free slot once its sound brief is ready.
parallel_constraints: One writer per file/component; HUD worker provides isolated widget, coordinator binds Main.
Material authoring stays separate from level geometry binding; explicit asset IDs are handed across.
Movement/bob must consume the accepted gun registration; layout must expose clearances before enemy placement.
Workers report completion/evidence, independent reviewer verifies integrated behavior; passing self-tests is not human acceptance.

defaults.hud: Industrial concept-style panel; readable health, armor, ammo/capacity, key icons and actual1–6 inventory slots. Selected distinct from owned.
defaults.minimap: Right HUD, north-up visited architecture, player heading; persisted on/off, full Tab map retained.
defaults.movement: Subtle adjustable grounded bob; holdCtrl real crouch; holdShift sprint1.35x, no stamina, firing allowed, crouch wins.
defaults.encounters: Named authored item ambushes, no random enemies on every pickup.
defaults.new_enemies: Infected scientist and facility security belong to Pale Ward only.
defaults.gore: Thick anatomical remains plus directional blood; bounded cosmetic physics, flat decals reserved for blood.
defaults.audio: Physical punch and separate weapon/material cues; no wet/slosh; existing music retained.
defaults.furnishing: Explicit rows, spacing and workflow groups; no generic perimeter fallback for key furniture.
